thread:
Jordan (product): Quick design review: tightening up ownership/permission UX on the Credentials page. Problem: users accidentally transfer keys and break services. Goal: clearer affordances, permission-aware CTAs, and a lightweight impact preview.
Marta (design): Idea: replace inline transfer with a single 'Manage ownership' modal. Modal step 1 = preview impact (collapsed by default), step 2 = choose destination + action (transfer / transfer+rotate / transfer+revoke). Keep rotate recommended with a subtle badge. Mobile -> stacked steps.
Owen (backend): API pattern: POST /v1/keys/:id/ownership {to: "team:platform", action: "transfer+rotate"} -> 202 job, returns job_id + blocked_reasons if any. Add /v1/keys/:id/impact for the preview. Impact may be async.
Zara (security): Defaults: prefer Rotate on transfer. Require elevated privileges for transfer to org-admin-only teams. Also require MFA if transfer affects >10 services. Log all transfers with actor, IP, and job_id.
Pat (content): Microcopy: Primary CTA when rotate=true = "Transfer & rotate". Warning banner inside modal: "This will change who can manage the credential. Some integrations may require manual updates." Notify checkbox label: "Email recipients about this change". For empty impact: "No linked services found — run a scan to be sure."
Yui (a11y): Accessibility: modal should have aria-modal=true and aria-labelledby. If we block action, announce reason with aria-live=assertive. Danger text must meet 4.5:1 contrast. For required confirmation (revoke) require typing the key slug and ensure screenreader reads helper text.
Marta (design): Visual affordance: add a small "ownership" chip on rows with owner avatar; overflow menu shows Manage ownership first (safer). For keys with cross-org exposure show a subtle red outline + hover tooltip: "Cross-org exposure".
Owen (backend): Edge cases: if impact scan is running, return {status: "scanning"} and UI should show spinner + hint: "Estimated impact may be incomplete." Also API will return specific errors: 403 insufficient_scope, 409 policy_block, 422 needed_admin_approval. UI should map these to helpful user messages.
Zara (security): If policy_block, surface remediation steps: "Request transfer approval" -> link to /orgs/:id/requests. For transfers with rotate auto-update option, ensure we don't leak secrets to external integrations without explicit consent and proper auth.
Pat (content): Toasts: success -> "Transfer started — view progress" (link to job). Partial failure -> "Transfer started for X targets; Y blocked. View details." For blocked CTA -> "Request approval".
Yui (a11y): For the impact list, make rows keyboard-focusable and provide an action to contact owners. If we expose a download CSV of affected endpoints, mark the link as sensitive and announce expiry.
ops-bot: Transfer job queued -> JOB-2212345-77, event=key.transfer queued
Jordan (product): Action items: @Marta update modal comps + mobile stack, @Pat write modal copy + toasts, @Yui produce a11y checklist (modal + confirm), @Owen document /impact + error codes, @Zara final policy gating + MFA thresholds. Aim for sign-off next Tue. :thumbsup:
